text:
Jamie W: Quick sync — we need a lightweight sampling + validation plan for audit events across API GW, Auth, Console, Billing, Runtime. Current coverage map shows gaps in runtime (session termination) and billing adjustment events. Plan idea: 1% random sampling for api-gw, 100% for admin-console ops, targeted hooks for KMS ops. Thoughts?
Asha R: +1. Also propose a schema-level assertion runner: small Python script to pull event samples and validate against canonical schema with clear failure signals. I can sketch a PR this week.
Mike L: Can we also include event provenance headers from api-gw? e.g. x-request-id, auth-method, tenant-id — those make customer validation easy.
Olga (seceng): For customer-facing evidence we must include requestor_email and role_at_time fields. Recent RBAC change removed role snapshots in a few paths; we should reintroduce or backfill for audit events. :eyes: 
Jamie W: Olga, can you paste a tiny sample of the desired schema fields so Asha can wire assertions?
Olga (seceng): Sure — minimal example: ```json
{
  "event_type": "session.terminate",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-02T13:22:11Z",
  "request_id": "req_01F2...",
  "actor": {"user_email":"alice@example.com","role_at_time":"admin"},
  "resource": {"id":"svc-123","type":"runtime"},
  "auth_method":"oauth2",
  "kms_key_id":"projects/prod/keys/redwood-key-1"
}
```
Asha R: Nice — I'll have the harness assert presence and types for those fields and add a sanitization step for PII. Will also add a flag to fail loudly for missing role_at_time.
sre-bot: audit-sampler scheduled: sample-job-staging started (job-772) :white_check_mark:
Mike L: For KMS integration, ensure we never ship raw keys in events — only reference ids and rotation metadata. Add kms_key_rotation:{"last_rotated":"2025-10-01","rotation_method":"auto"} to event metadata.
Olga (seceng): Also flag: vuln triage uncovered possible user metadata serialization that could leak PII in runtime logs. Need sanitizer + test coverage before we enable full sampling for runtime. I'll add to backlog.
Jamie W: Actionable owners: API GW -> Mike L, Auth -> Asha R, Console -> Olga (seceng), Billing -> Mike L, Runtime -> Asha R. I'll create JIRA tickets and link to PRs.
Asha R: ACK — I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4321 to add assertion harness + a small Kafka consumer for sampling. Will include configuration for sampling rate per service.
deploy-bot: deployment started for sampling-runner v1 on staging (deploy-1234) :rocket:
Mike L: For billing events, include both pre_adjustment and post_adjustment amounts and the actor metadata; customers often need this for invoicing disputes.
Olga (seceng): Adding automated customer-facing validation checklist to the ticket: ensure role_at_time, request_id, tenant_id, and no PII in freeform metadata.
Jamie W: Great. Schedule: Asha to land assertion harness by EOD Wed, Mike to add headers in api-gw by Thurs, Olga to add sanitizer and checklist by Thurs. Reconvene Thurs 10am to triage backlog. :calendar:
